reason: Before this patch, IsHealthy called s.Init(), which returned the s.initErr that Stop() sets to "service is stopping" or "service is stopped" (pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:321,339). The patch removes that call, so IsHealthy (server.go:934-935) now just calls diagnostics.IsHealthy. For the SQL backend that only pings the DB and returns SERVING (sql/backend.go:109-116), and backend.Stop only cancels a context without closing the DB (sql/backend.go:119-122).
